01 / The starting point

A question worth exploring.

Which direction—cybersecurity or data analytics—best fits the skills I am developing as an Information Systems major, and how is AI changing the work?

The public goal

Build evidence of technical problem-solving and clear communication, then use practical projects to make a more informed career choice.

The working assumption

I do not need a final career title yet. Comparing real responsibilities and trying both kinds of work should make the next decision clearer.

This is a research plan. Interests are known; personal fit and skill readiness still need testing.

02 / Original employer evidence

Three roles. Different perspectives.

One FDE, one AI technology role, and one healthcare AI role. Open each record for requirements and interpretation.

These are experienced-role examples, not a representative sample of entry-level jobs. They show possible destinations; they do not establish that an IS degree alone meets the requirements.
01
FDE · Consulting & technology

Palantir Forward Deployed Engineer

Accenture
Original employer page ↗

Turns client needs into deployed applications and data pipelines. Works with technical and business teams, prototypes solutions, and improves them using feedback.

Publication date not listed on reviewed page · Accessed November 11, 2026

Explore requirements, AI connection & learning gaps
AI connection · employer evidence

Uses Palantir Foundry and AIP; the requirements explicitly include applied AI and prompt engineering.

Required / eligibility

3+ years each in data engineering, cloud platforms, and Python, PySpark, or Java; 1+ year each with Foundry/Gotham and applied Palantir AI. CS/Engineering bachelor’s or stated experience alternatives.

Preferred / conditions

No separate preferred list captured in this review. Travel may range from 0–100%.

Learning priorities · interpretation

Evidence to build: a working data pipeline, a deployed application, and a clear explanation of a user’s problem.

02
AI-related role · Technology

Security Engineer / Research Engineer, RL Security

Anthropic
Original employer page ↗

Builds security controls for reinforcement-learning infrastructure, reviews code, fixes weaknesses, and documents designs while preserving system performance.

Publication date not listed on reviewed page · Accessed November 11, 2026

Explore requirements, AI connection & learning gaps
AI connection · employer evidence

The work directly protects the infrastructure used to train AI systems.

Required / eligibility

Python plus a systems language; production distributed/security systems experience; Linux, containers, cloud, and security fundamentals. Bachelor’s or equivalent education/training/experience. Office presence is generally at least 25%.

Preferred / conditions

ML infrastructure, Kubernetes, isolation/access controls, fleet observability, and RL or language-model training experience.

Learning priorities · interpretation

Evidence to build: Linux practice, secure coding, and a documented investigation. This is a long-term engineering example, not a beginner analyst posting.

03
AI in another industry · Healthcare

AI Governance Data Scientist — Remote

UnitedHealth Group / Optum
Original employer page ↗

Tests AI systems, analyzes results with Python, documents findings, and communicates with legal, compliance, and development teams. Includes privacy exposure and conversational-AI testing.

Published November 3, 2026 · Requisition 2382289 · Accessed November 11, 2026

Explore requirements, AI connection & learning gaps
AI connection · employer evidence

Part of a responsible AI program in healthcare, combining model evaluation with governance.

Required / eligibility

7+ years practicing AI; 5+ years each in AI lifecycle work, traditional modeling, and generative/agentic AI. Requires stakeholder communication and AI ethics understanding. Remote within the US.

Preferred / conditions

Software engineering, AI governance, conversational AI, security principles, and healthcare/regulatory familiarity.

Learning priorities · interpretation

Evidence to build: a reproducible analysis and model-testing report. This is an experienced AI role; data science and entry-level data analytics are not interchangeable.

Method: AI-assisted discovery and drafting; factual summaries checked against original employer descriptions on November 11, 2026. Posting availability can change. Unlisted publication dates remain unlisted. No salary ranking or hiring-probability claims are made.

03 / The comparison

Protect systems. Or explain patterns.

A working comparison to guide practice—not a verdict about an entire profession.

QuestionCybersecurity directionData analytics direction
Problem to exploreHow can a system be better protected, and what evidence signals a problem?What does a dataset reveal, and how can it support a decision?
Employer signalAnthropic emphasizes security controls, code review, infrastructure, and written designs.Accenture emphasizes pipelines and decision support; Optum emphasizes testing results and stakeholder reports.
Practice focusLinux, networking concepts, log interpretation, secure coding.SQL, data cleaning, Python analysis, visual explanation.
Possible portfolio proofA synthetic-log investigation with evidence and recommendations.A public-data analysis with a question, reproducible steps, and limitations.
AI connectionProtecting AI infrastructure is explicit in the Anthropic role.AI testing and applied-AI deployment appear in the Optum and Accenture roles.
Question still openDo I enjoy investigating ambiguous events and explaining risk?Do I enjoy cleaning messy data and explaining what it can—and cannot—show?
Interpretation: The practice topics are proposed learning priorities, not a universal employer checklist. AI governance may offer an intersection of data, privacy, and security. These three postings cannot establish typical analyst requirements; entry-level analyst research is a next step.
04 / Portfolio design decisions

Make the thinking visible.

Primary reader: an internship recruiter evaluating an Information Systems student’s reasoning, communication, and developing technical skills. A class partner is the immediate usability reviewer.

Selected for this research site

Fieldnotes / calm & clear

Burgundy, warm paper, serif headings, and numbered sections. Evidence stays next to its source. A single page keeps the comparison and next step close together.

Alternative to test

Signal / precise & technical

Navy, white, and teal with a structured project grid. A possible future direction if technical demonstrations become the portfolio’s main content.

Four stories to earn through practice.

Planned story concepts. No projects or results below are claimed as completed.

01 / Planned

Following the clues

Investigate synthetic login logs. Show observations, possible explanations, and the limits of the evidence.

02 / Planned

From rows to a reason

Clean a public dataset and answer one focused question with a chart and reproducible analysis.

03 / Planned

Checking the AI

Test an AI-generated claim against original documentation and explain the correction. Publish on the separate exploration site.

04 / Planned

Better after feedback

Show a partner’s specific observation, the accepted change, and the result of their retry.

05 / The next experiment

Try the work.
Then compare.

Proposed next step: spend equal time on one small security exercise and one data analysis. Record what was interesting, difficult, and worth exploring again.

A practical plan / not yet run

Investigate. Review a synthetic login dataset and document one suspicious pattern without claiming it proves an attack.

Analyze. Clean a public dataset, answer one question, and explain a chart’s limitations.

Reflect privately. Compare enjoyment and learning needs in Canvas. Publish only suitable goals and project evidence.
